profile.headline: Senior Scientist at Voatz
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer with Voatz, whose mission is to increase election access and integrity via mobile voting. My professional interests are in a wide array of areas.
* Cryptography and Computational Number Theory
* Discrete Optimization and Heuristics
* Cryptocurrencies and Blockchain Technology
* Data Analytics and Mathematical Modeling
* Open Educational Resources: Two OERs in progress are Open Applied Calculus and Open Introduction to Cryptography (https://github.com/elandqui/OpenAppliedCalculus and https://github.com/elandqui/OpenIntroCrypto).

positions.title: Item Writer
positions.description: Wrote and reviewed Algebra and Geometry questions for standardized tests for Oklahoma public schools.

positions.title: Cryptologic Mathematician - Director's Summer Program
positions.description: Worked on projects critical to the security of the United States and briefed NSA Director Gen. Michael Hayden.

positions.title: Production Planning Assistant
positions.description:
Developed statistical models for pricing industrial ceramic products and programmed
an automated work-flow system.
